issue.title: Using only country in nomenclature config breaks CodeList

summary.text: The bug was reproduced: a test fails before the fix and passes after it, no regressions were found, and the one behaviour change (arguments to DataStructureConfig.repos) was judged intended, but the tests did not kill enough mutants for L2 and Break My Fix was inconclusive. Next, look at whether the tests actually guard the fixed path for a region config with only the country attribute and no rep…
